import sys, zipfile, subprocess, tempfile, os
archive_path = sys.argv[1]
out_path = "percentages.tsv"
rows = []
with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path) as z:
    for info in z.infolist():
        if not info.filename.endswith(".faa.mafft"):
            continue
        data = z.read(info)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            aln = os.path.join(td, "aln.fa")
            with open(aln, "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)
            out = subprocess.check_output(["phykit", "pis", aln], text=True).strip()
        fields = out.split("\t")
        if len(fields) < 3:
            raise RuntimeError("unexpected phykit output: " + out)
        pct = fields[2].strip()
        rows.append((info.filename, pct))
rows.sort()
with open(out_path, "w") as f:
    for name, pct in rows:
        f.write(name + "\t" + pct + "\n")
